harness_repair.diagnosis: This sandbox's checkout had root npm dependencies (including @agentv/core) never installed, so evaluate_model.py --ship-gates crashed in publish_model_evaluation before producing a scoreboard. A second, deeper issue surfaced investigating this: the sandbox exports a NODE_OPTIONS (--import tsx) this Node build rejects with exit 9, which would have broken the AgentV runner subprocess (and the OpenUI lang-core bridge used by data generation) even after installing the SDK, since only src/slm_training/dsl/grammar/backends/graphql_js.py already sanitized NODE_OPTIONS before spawning node.
harness_repair.fix_summary: Added `npm ci` to scripts/setup_dev_env.sh for the AgentV SDK, then generalized graphql_js.py's existing NODE_OPTIONS workaround into a shared bridge_utils.sanitized_node_env() helper used by lang_core.py (OpenUI bridge, one-shot invoke + REPL) and evals/agentv.py (AgentV runner), with regression tests at each call site.

next_priority: replay identical frozen arm (retry_measurement) now that torch, the AgentV SDK, and NODE_OPTIONS sanitization are all in place and evaluate_model.py should reach a real scoreboard
